report.summary: 4 narrowed + 1 confirmed finding: fix freshness prefix collision, validate handoff mint, enforce dry-run default, fix accepted island suppression, and guard linked worktree path leak.
risks: The freshness prefix collision fix requires regex pattern inspection and may need a minimum length enforcement.
The handoff mint validation may require schema definition and changes in multiple files.
The dry-run default enforcement depends on main() implementation which is not fully visible.
The accepted island suppression fix may have broader impact on drift detection logic.
The linked worktree path leak fix may require test infrastructure for linked worktrees.
todos: Inspect _ABBREV_SHA_RE regex pattern and minimum length.
Inspect mint_task_from_landed_edit for validation of 'wrote' key.
Grep for 'def main' in daedalus/spine/picker.py and check dry-run enforcement.
Write unit test for drift.py to verify accepted island suppression.
Write test for linked worktree path leak.

items.title: Fix linked worktree path leak in mint_from_diffs
items.why_now: Critical severity: if _is_linked_worktree returns false negative, absolute paths become unresolvable after worktree deletion, causing unrecoverable errors.

steps.do: Write a test that creates a linked worktree, mints a task, deletes the worktree, and verifies that resolve_task_repo fails gracefully (returns None) rather than raising.
Add defensive check in mint_from_diffs to re-verify worktree is not linked before storing path, or sanitize path to relative form.
steps.verified_by: Run the test above and ensure it passes

items.assumption: The location of mint_from_diffs and resolve_task_repo is unknown; need to locate them in the repository.

items.title: Fix accepted island suppression in drift.py
items.why_now: Confirmed high severity: accepted islands are incorrectly classified as NEW_ISLAND, suppressing legitimate drift findings.

steps.do: Write a unit test for drift.py that creates a snapshot with an island module and an acceptance for that island, then verifies that the module is not suppressed in the BECAME ISLAND category.
Modify drift.py logic to exclude accepted island keys from known_unreached when computing was_reached, or adjust filtering after baselined_islands.
steps.verified_by: Run the test above; ensure accepted island appears in BECAME_ISLAND output.

items.assumption: The file drift.py exists and contains the logic described; test file tests/test_drift.py may need to be created.

items.title: Validate handoff mint structure in mint_task_from_landed_edit
items.why_now: High severity: missing validation of report['wrote'] makes the function fragile to changes in offload.py's output format.

steps.do: Inspect mint_task_from_landed_edit definition in mint.py; check if it validates 'wrote' key type/content.
steps.verified_by: Grep for 'def mint_task_from_landed_edit' and inspect its body; verify if any isinstance or schema check exists.

steps.do: If validation is missing, add type/schema validation for report['wrote'] (e.g., assert isinstance(report['wrote'], list) and each element is a dict with required keys).
steps.verified_by: Run existing tests; write a test that passes invalid 'wrote' and expects a clear error.

items.assumption: mint_task_from_landed_edit is in daedalus/spine/mint.py; if not, adjust path.

items.title: Enforce dry-run default in picker main()
items.why_now: Medium severity: if main() does not enforce dry-run default, operators may inadvertently trigger actions contrary to documentation.

steps.do: Grep for 'def main' in daedalus/spine/picker.py and inspect if it enforces dry-run (e.g., no --apply flag, default action is dry-run).
steps.verified_by: Show the main() code; verify that actions are only performed when explicitly requested (e.g., --apply).

steps.do: If dry-run is not enforced, add logic to make dry-run the default (e.g., require --apply to perform actions).
steps.verified_by: Run picker with no arguments and verify it only prints what it would do; run with --apply and verify actions are performed.

items.assumption: main() is in daedalus/spine/picker.py; the docstring accurately describes intended behavior.

items.title: Fix freshness prefix collision by enforcing minimum abbreviation length
items.why_now: Medium severity: if _ABBREV_SHA_RE allows fewer than 7 hex characters, prefix matching can cause false freshness.

steps.do: Print the regex pattern for _ABBREV_SHA_RE and check minimum length.
steps.verified_by: Run a script that imports the module and prints _ABBREV_SHA_RE.pattern.

steps.do: Run test with recorded='a' and actual='abcdef1' to see if startswith passes.
If minimum length is insufficient, update _ABBREV_SHA_RE to require at least 7 hex characters.
steps.verified_by: Re-run the test and verify it fails appropriately.

items.assumption: The file containing _ABBREV_SHA_RE is unknown; likely in a module related to freshness validation.
